Carbonnade is most commonly eaten with a variety of sauces (aka sauce rosette) and frites, but it is also eaten on its own. I found this recipe:
Ingredients
1 kilogram rump steak (beef)
150 grams rashers bacon
500 grams potatoes (peeled)
1 medium onion
1 garlic clove
6 peppercorns
1 bay leaf
1 tsp parsley
4 tbsp flour
1⁄2 liter red wine
1⁄2 liter beef stock (bouillon)
3 tbsp tomato puree
3 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
A dash of lemon juice
How To
Cook the bacon until crispy. Drain on paper towels and set aside.
Cut the meat into pieces. Brown the meat on all sides in a heavy pan. Remove and set aside.
Remove all but 1 tbsp of the bacon fat from the pan and add the onions, garlic, peppercorns, bay leaf, parsley and flour. Cook on low heat for about 5 minutes.
Add the wine, stock, tomato puree, Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice. Simmer for about 5 minutes.
Add the meat and bacon and cook over a low heat for about 30 minutes.
Mash the potatoes and add to the pan. Cook for about 10 more minutes.

Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).  
For the crust:
 
In a food processor, add:
- 1 cup (200g) all-purpose flour 
- 2 tbsp (30g) granulated sugar
- 1⁄4 tsp (1g) salt
- 1⁄2 cup (120g) unsalted butter, melted 
- 2 tbsp (30g) cold water
Pulse until the dough is crumbly, about 30 seconds.

- 3 oz (75g) cream cheese, softened
- 3⁄4 cup (180g) granulated sugar
- 1 tsp (5g) pure vanilla extract
- 3 tbsp (25g) cornstarch
- 2 cups (480g) heavy cream
- 6 tbsp (35g) confectioners’ sugar

Here’s a recipe for Beef Pochero from the website AllRecipes.com.  It’s a classic Filipino dish that consists of beef, potatoes, carrots, and other vegetables, all cooked in a broth.  The recipe calls for beef chuck roast, but you could also use beef short ribs or beef stew meat.  Here’s the full recipe:
Ingredients:
1 pound beef chuck roast, cut into cubes
1/2 cup all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon salt
1 teaspoon black pepper
1 tablespoon vegetable oil
1 onion, diced
4 cloves garlic, minced
2 cups beef broth
1 cup water
1/2 cup tomato sauce
1/2 cup carrots, diced
1/2 cup potatoes, diced
1/2 cup green beans, trimmed and cut into 1-inch pieces
1/2 cup green bell pepper, diced
1/2 cup red bell pepper, diced
1/2 cup yellow bell pepper, diced
1/2 cup celery, diced
1/2 cup green onions, sliced
1/2 cup parsley, chopped
1/4 cup cilantro, chopped
Instructions:
1.  In a large bowl, mix together the beef chuck roast, flour, salt, and black pepper.  Toss to coat the beef cubes evenly.
2.  Heat the vegetable oil in a large pot over medium heat.  Add the beef cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.  Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
3.  Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.  Add the beef broth, water, tomato sauce, carrots, potatoes, green beans, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, celery, green onions, parsley, and cilantro.  Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
4.  Add the beef back to the pot and simmer for another 30 minutes, or until the beef is tender.  Serve hot with rice or noodles.

Ingredients:
(3 whole ducks)
Preparation:
For the first day:  Slice one duck into six parts (slicing from tail to breast along the backbone), leave the other three ducks whole.  Wash the pieces in salt water.
For the second day:  Smear the duck pieces with ginger juice (very finely sliced ginger), salt, sugar, soy sauce and sesame oil, and let them sit for a few hours.  When you’re ready to cook, put them in a deep pot and fill it with water to cover, add a pinch of black pepper, star anise, and a little bit of Sichuan peppercorn and cook them at a slow boil for about 45 minutes.
For the third day:  Put some soy sauce, five spice powder, black bean paste, honey and sesame oil in the pot and boil them in the duck for 5 minutes.  For the other three ducks, wash them in salt water and cover with a marinade of ginger juice, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and sesame oil, and let them sit for about 15 minutes.
Final preparation:  Cook the three remaining ducks for 20 minutes at low heat, with the marinade in the pot.  When you’re ready to serve, take the cooked pieces out of the pot and reheat them on the fire.  Put the pot of boiled duck on a table and pour the liquid from it into a sauce bowl.
Tips:  After you take the cooked duck pieces out of the pot, place them on a chopping block and chop them into small, bite-sized pieces.  Serve with ginger-vinegar sauce, rice wine and tea. USER: Whoa, so this recipe will require multiple days of preparation?

1 tablespoon of lemon juice
1 teaspoon of vanilla extract

In a medium bowl, mix together the pecans, brown sugar, and melted butter.  Spread the mixture evenly over the pie crust, and bake for 30-35 minutes, or until the filling is set and the crust is golden brown.  Let the pie cool completely before serving.

1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon

2 eggs
3 ripe bananas, mashed
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
1 cup chopped walnuts (optional)
Instructions:
